body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Haier presented its new mp3 mobile phone ‘Y-MP3190’ dubbed ‘Elegance’ during CES 2007. With a black round compact design, it measures 3.5x1.25x0.75-inch. This GSM phone supports OLED display, mp3 playback, FM stereo tuner, Bluetooth stereo transmitter, USB memory drive, voice recorder, internal 128MB memory, a trans-flash memory expansion slot for additional memory capacity.
It will be available in February. The China company released a pen phone last CES 2006.
